{"metadata":{"description":"Secondary working directories for a DeepSeek Harness project — edit a source repo, a test repo, and a docs repo side by side without leaving the primary workspace.","id":"gh:1334119885","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-multi-folder","slug":"AngelosZou/dsh-multi-folder","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Secondary working directories for a DeepSeek Harness project — edit a source repo, a test repo, and "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"a docs repo side by side without leaving the primary workspace."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-multi-folder"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Secondary working directories for a DeepSeek Harness project — edit a source repo, a test repo, an"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"d a docs repo side by side without leaving the primary workspace."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that gives one project (workspace) a set of **secondary working dir"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"Harness plugin bundle that gives one project (workspace) a set of **secondary working directories**:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- The agent's core `cwd` and every other core attribute keep pointing at the **primary workspace**.
"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"- Under **Workspace Write** mode the agent gains the **same read / write / edit / execute permission"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"s** on the configured secondary directories as on the primary workspace — enforced by re-rooting the"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" session's own sandbox policy, so every mode keeps its semantics (`read-only` still denies, `workspa"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ce-write` allows, `danger-full-access` allows).
- The directory list is **injected into the system p"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"rompt** and re-rendered per session assembly.
- Configuration changes notify the agent through a **n"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"on-interrupting message queue** — delivered at the next message boundary (user send or tool-call end"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"), and **only when the directory set actually changed**.
- Configurable **before the session starts*"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"*: the session-creation page (new-session screen) offers a Multi-folder entry that reads and edits t"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"he same per-workspace configuration through a **sessionless remote API** (`multiFolder/*` endpoints)"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" — no session id required.
- The **`@` file menu finds files in the configured directories**. The sh"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ipped `@` menu only ever searches the primary workspace, so this plugin contributes its own `@` grou"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"p listing the secondary directories — headed by each directory.
- **No new tools.** Everything is a "},{"id":"p6s14","text":"framework-level change (tool-pipeline interception) plus a UI-level change (a session-scoped header "},{"id":"p6s15","text":"rk-level change (tool-pipeline interception) plus a UI-level change (a session-scoped header entry)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- Node.js >= 20
- A DSH profile composed from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Link this repository into a DSH profile:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Then **restart the DSH backend** (host composition loads at process start) and **refresh the browser"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" page** (the client bundle is served `no-cache`)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Choose the plugin version that matches your DeepSeek Harness release:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| DeepSeek Harness | Install |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| 0.1.1 or earlier | `dsh-multi-folder@0.1.7` |
| 0.1.2-alpha or later | the latest `dsh-multi-folde"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"1.1 or earlier | `dsh-multi-folder@0.1.7` |
| 0.1.2-alpha or later | the latest `dsh-multi-folder` |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"A Multi-folder button appears in the session header, and a second entry appears on the **session-cre"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ation page**: a chip row directly above the composer card (the same band the git-branch chip uses), "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"aligned with the workspace/preset chips of the new-session screen. Clicking it opens the panel as a "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"popover anchored to the chip. Exactly one session-creation entry is ever shown — the plugin register"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"s three candidate seats and elects the best available one (upstream `conversation.hero.workspaceExtr"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"as` chip > `conversation.input.dock` row > fixed bottom-right launcher for shells declaring neither)"},{"id":"p18s7","text":". The panel lets you:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Action | Behavior |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Add directory | Uses the host's native picker, then its OS dialog on failure; a `browse` capabilit"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"y opens the client browser directly (path field, one level of child directories, optional new folder"},{"id":"p20s3","text":") |
| Open in file manager | Opens the host's file manager (Explorer / Finder) at a configured direc"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"tory |
| Remove / refresh | Applies immediately |
| Switch session | The panel auto-switches to that"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" session's directories |
| Reopen panel | Uses the per-session cache — no redundant command rows |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Equivalent slash command for the user:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The agent needs nothing extra: `read` / `glob` / `grep` work everywhere, and `write` / `edit` / `pws"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"h` / `bash` are intercepted and re-rooted automatically when the target path (or `workdir`) falls in"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"side a configured secondary directory."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Interception** — a listener on the `tools/execute` around-dispatch waterfall short-circuits `wri"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"te` / `edit` / `pwsh` / `bash` calls whose resolved path (or `workdir`) lands inside a configured se"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"condary directory, and executes them with the session's standing sandbox policy **re-rooted to that "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"directory** (`{ ...standingPolicy, workspaceRoot: secondaryDir }`). The mode itself is untouched, wh"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"ich is what gives every sandbox mode its identical primary-workspace semantics for free. Paths are c"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"anonicalized through `fs.resolve` + `processPath` before matching, so `..`, symlinks, and case diffe"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"rences behave correctly.
- **Prompt injection** — one ordered `systemPrompt` section with a text pro"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"vider evaluated per assembly, rendering only for sessions whose workspace has configured directories"},{"id":"p25s9","text":".
- **Notifications** — a pending notice armed by the command handler (only on actual change) is con"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"sumed at the next boundary by either the `agent/pre-step` waterfall (prepend into the entering messa"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"ge batch) or the `tools/post-execute` waterfall (attach as `additionalContexts`), whichever fires fi"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"rst — the framework's native plugin-sourced `notice` context.
- **Configuration & security boundary*"},{"id":"p25s13","text":"* — per-workspace config lives in a host-owned store outside every agent sandbox root (`<DSH_HOME>/s"},{"id":"p25s14","text":"torages/multi-folder/<workspace-key>.json`). Direct `write`/`edit` attempts against the config file "},{"id":"p25s15","text":"are rejected with an explicit message — **the agent can never self-grant directories; configuration "},{"id":"p25s16","text":"is user-managed by design**. See SECURITY.md.
- **Sessionless remote API** — a `multiFolder` namespa"},{"id":"p25s17","text":"ce registered through `ctx.typert.register` (hand-written `src-json` descriptors) plus a plain-objec"},{"id":"p25s18","text":"t service provided as `multiFolder`. Its `list`/`add`/`remove`/`set` methods are keyed by workspace "},{"id":"p25s19","text":"**path** and share one validated core with the `/multi-folder` command, so the creation page can con"},{"id":"p25s20","text":"figure directories before any session exists. `browse`/`makeDir` serve the plugin's directory browse"},{"id":"p25s21","text":"r; `pick`/`reveal` select or open a host directory.
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
